'''Skeetos''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of creature that lived in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. They had thin bodies with multiple wings. The species used its sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] to grip onto the vermin that it preyed upon. To [[Death/Legends|kill]] its prey, Skeetos would bite down on the creature until it died from loss of [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. It was rumored that larger Skeetos could carry off small [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].
